executive_summary: U.S. equity futures are flat-to-slightly-positive ahead of a data-heavy week, with S&P futures +0.19% and Nasdaq +0.32%. The market's attention is split between geopolitical risk (Hormuz shipping disruptions keeping oil at $78) and Wednesday's July CPI release, which will shape the Fed's September decision (51% rate-hike probability currently priced). The universe scanner found unusual breadth with seven 5/5 setups — led by SE (earnings today), ABNB, NET, JD, TPR, DDS, and TSCO — all showing strong relative strength and volume confirmation in RISK_ON regime. Pre-market movers include RIOT (+18% on $9.1B Anthropic deal), NIQ (+42% earnings beat), and ONON (-20% earnings miss). The semiconductor supercycle continues with TSMC posting +45% YoY revenue growth and raising 2026 outlook to 40%+. China tariff 90-day extension provides near-term relief but Aug 23 escalation risk looms.

macro_events.counterargument: Core services ex-shelter has been decelerating for 3 months; one print won't alter the disinflationary trajectory

macro_events.causal_chain: Houthi attacks near Qeshm Island → shipping insurance premiums spike → VLCC rerouting around Cape of Good Hope adds $2M+/trip → Brent/WTI premium widens to $78 → energy costs flow to consumer prices.
